def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

                edge |= y in (0, h - 1) or x in (0, w - 1)

from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            component = []
            touches_edge = False
            while q:

                component.append((y, x))
